description: This file defines data models, query parameters, and a fetcher class for accessing available indicators from EconDB, including methods for transforming queries, extracting data asynchronously, and transforming raw data into model instances.

classes.name: EconDbAvailableIndicatorsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching available indicators, including a cache usage option.

classes.name: EconDbAvailableIndicatorsData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for available indicators, including metadata like currency, scale, and date range.

classes.name: EconDbAvailableIndicatorsFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching, transforming, and processing available indicators data from EconDB asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into an EconDbAvailableIndicatorsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously downloads indicator data, raises an error if data is empty, and returns sorted records.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data dictionaries into validated EconDbAvailableIndicatorsData model instances.
